newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB leads UK banking stocks higher.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB leads UK banking stocks higher.

text.p: British banking shares were squeezed higher on Monday as the sector continued to attract investors and market-makers were caught short of stock, dealers said.
Shares in Lloyds TSB Group Plc climbed 14-1/2p to 501 by 0955 GMT while Bank of Scotland Plc gained 10p to 371 and National Westminster Bank Plc firmed 19p to 815.
Royal Bank of Scotland Plc rose seven pence to 606-1/2 and Barclays Plc climbed 12-1/2p to 11.81 stg.
The banking sector has outperformed the UK stock market since the start of the year and market-makers said it was continuing to be favoured by investors.
"A lot of people have cash to invest but they're wary about the manufacturing sector until we've seen what their results are like, so they're going for banks," one market maker said.
Another said: "People are still chasing stock and then we get a squeeze on and up they go."
Lloyds TSB is due to kick off the UK bank reporting season with annual results on Friday.
